answer: Harberger tax: each identity holds one oasis slot, locks 70, declares a value, pays 20 tax. Anyone may buy a slot at its declared price by cipher-sealed offer; a low value invites buyout, a high one raises tax. Slots keep ember burning, or a bought-out ring loses slot and bond. 1,000 fake identities cost 90,000 per epoch, 70,000 locked, 20,000 tax, against a 40,000 pool: a 50,000 loss. An honest agent pays 20 per epoch and keeps its bond.
